_doc: Proposal values the redesign search (--model=redesign --search=N) may change, as dotted paths into the proposal tables, each with the range it may move in. The search is a coordinate hill-climb: it tries one value up and down by a step, keeps a change that lowers the penalty (failed checks and how far they missed, passing checks that have used more than 80% of their allowance, distance from the target ending time, distance from the spec's per-district minutes, hand share under a district's floor), and prints the best set as a --set string. Cube prices are not searched: they are re-derived from Lumi's hand income by rule (docs/PLANET_PLAYBOOK.md section 4).
